parameters.jsCode:
/**
 * Notify expert about KB change that needs review.
 * Uses WF_EXPERT_NOTIFICATION via Execute Workflow or direct notification.
 * 
 * The notification includes:
 * - What changed and why
 * - AISHA's impact assessment
 * - Specific questions AISHA surfaced for the expert
 * - Detected context gaps
 * - Action items
 */
const report = $input.first().json;

const notification = {
  type: 'kb_change_review',
  severity: report.severity,
  title: `KB Sync Review: ${report.change_summary}`,
  body: [
    `## KB Change — ${report.severity}`,
    '',
    `**Změna:** ${report.change_summary}`,
    `**Ragnarok sync:** ${report.ragnarok_sync}`,
    '',
    '### Impact factors',
    ...(report.impact_factors || []).map(f => `- ${f}`),
    '',
    '### AISHA dotazy pro experta',
    ...(report.surface_for_expert || []).map(q => `- **[${q.urgency}]** ${q.question}${q.context ? `\n  _${q.context}_` : ''}`),
    '',
    '### Detekované mezery',
    ...(report.detected_gaps || []).map(g => `- **${g.type}:** ${g.description}\n  → ${g.suggestion}`),
  ].join('\n'),
  metadata: {
    source: 'aisha_kb_sync',
    auto_generated: true,
    context_questions: report.context_questions,
    evaluated_at: report.evaluated_at
  }
};

return [{ json: notification }];

parameters.rpcParams: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_source_table: $('Parse Change Event').item.json.sourceTable, p_source_slug: $('Parse Change Event').item.json.sourceSlug, p_action: $('Parse Change Event').item.json.action, p_ragnarok_ok: $json.ragnarok_sync === 'OK', p_severity: $json.severity, p_needs_review: $json.needs_expert_review }) }}
